experiment: Existing Landsat and proxy baseline reproduction
central_finding: Endpoint support 95.7371%; 16.9284% met at least two adverse spectral criteria; 1.4220% met all three.
reason: Core reproducibility anchor; terminology must remain relative landscape pressure.

central_finding: Four weather cells cover 17 geolocated components; each cell contains 12784 complete daily records for 1991 to 2025.
reason: Required for provenance and completeness; detailed inventories belong in supplementary material.

central_finding: Annual, seasonal, monthly and extreme-weather summaries were generated from QC-passed ERA5-Seamless data.
reason: Central climate context; full tables are too detailed for the main narrative.

central_finding: Annual precipitation agreement was weak, Spearman rho 0.0826, and trend directions disagreed.
reason: Important product uncertainty result; neither product is ground truth.

central_finding: Open-Meteo annual precipitation slope was -10.3037 mm/year and mean temperature slope was 0.041753 degC/year, with moving-block intervals and FDR correction.
reason: Headline climate result with explicit reanalysis and baseline-sensitivity caveats.

central_finding: E2024 was not the wettest epoch in the Open-Meteo 30, 90 or 365 day scene-date windows.
reason: Corrects the legacy uniformly-wet interpretation and is central to temporal interpretation.

central_finding: All lag associations use only five independent epochs and are unstable under leave-one-epoch checks.
reason: Descriptive only; no p values, causality or strong inference.

central_finding: Elevation, slope, terrain roughness and position, D8 flow, wetness proxy and drainage distance were derived at 250, 500 and 1000 m supports.
reason: A core CHIP domain; these variables are susceptibility proxies without field hydrological validation.

central_finding: The fixed E2024 500 m local score ranked Giri first at 0.591176.
reason: Central decision-support result; must be paired with ranking uncertainty.

central_finding: Rank agreement was rho 0.918455 for 500 versus 1000 m and rho 0.710784 for 250 versus 1000 m.
reason: Shows that analytical support changes component ordering.

central_finding: NDVI-pressure and NDBI-pressure were strongly correlated, rho 0.971707, and were grouped into one surface-cover subdomain.
reason: Justifies hierarchical weighting and prevents double counting.

central_finding: Leaving MNDWI out produced rho -0.279583 and maximum rank change 13; terrain and drainage removals also changed rankings materially.
reason: Identifies which design assumptions control ranking behaviour.

central_finding: Fifty thousand Dirichlet weight draws gave Giri median rank 1 with 2.5 to 97.5 percentile ranks 1 to 9 and top-three probability 0.77398.
reason: Replaces unsupported confidence in one equal-weight ranking.

central_finding: Two thousand 150 m spectral-block draws gave Bhallar median rank 1 and Giri median rank 2 with overlapping intervals.
reason: Essential distinction between fixed score and sampling-sensitive rank.

central_finding: Development-selected random forest achieved outer-stripe macro-F1 0.821433 with 95% block-bootstrap interval 0.691099 to 0.835178.
reason: OUT OF SCOPE for the submitted article (2026-09-20): the land-cover classification benchmark was removed from the manuscript. Result retained in the archive; supports no claim.

central_finding: Earthquake, flood, landslide, quarry and population layers were not added.
reason: The central experiment did not require them and no harmonised validated event inventory was supplied.
